name: faa-airmen-registry-mcp-server
description: Search FAA airmen certificates, ratings, and informational medical records via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

mirror_dir.title: Mirror directory
mirror_dir.description: Persistent local mirror directory; use the same directory for the lifecycle CLI.

include_location.title: Include city and ZIP
include_location.description: Opt in to importing city and ZIP fields; displaying and filtering them also needs personal-data redaction off.

redact_pii.title: Redact personal data
redact_pii.description: Serving-time personal-data redaction: name searches need first and last name, city and ZIP are hidden, and medical lookups are refused. Turn off only for a personal local install.

stale_after_days.title: Source-age warning days
stale_after_days.description: Source-age warning threshold, integer 1–366; never a credential validity assessment.
